Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! England players are seen in the huddle before they disperse to take their respective positions. Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt are the openers for South Africa Women. Katherine Brunt has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, England have a decent score on the board and given by the struggle of South African batters so far in the tournament, they would be hoping to defend this one. South African batters, on the other hand, would also be looking to step up and chase this modest total. Runs on the board in crucial encounters like this are always important and let's see how the South African batters go about their business. Stay tuned for the chase.

Marizanne Kapp is down for a quick chat. She says that it feels like she's been playing and bowling forever but is happy with her performance. About Klaas says that even she picked up the five wickets but Klaas was their best bowler today and deserved more wickets than her. Kapp adds that under lights it will be an interesting chase and hopes that the batters do the job and get going in the tournament as well.

The strength of this South African side is their pace bowling and it showed yet again as they started off in a brilliant fashion bowling nagging lines and lengths. Kapp was the pick of the bowlers as she got two early wickets and then came back in the last 10 overs to take three more wickets and ended with a much-deserved five-wicket haul. Credit should also be given to Klaas as she took two important wickets of Beaumont and Sciver and overall it has been another strong bowling performance by South Africa, especially given the absence of star bowler Shabnim Ismail in the second half of the innings.

England were under a bit of pressure coming into this game with two losses in their first two games and that showed in their batting display upfront. They were a bit tentative and ended up losing three early wickets. The move to send Wyatt at the top of the order didn’t work and English were in all sorts of trouble. However, Beaumont and Jones stitched together a century stand and the stage was set to explode with both set batters in. However, just when they were looking to up the ante both the set batters were sent back to the hut and that derailed England’s progress. Wickets kept falling at regular intervals and that meant that England have fallen short of the total they have hoped for coming into the last 15 overs.

This has been another superb bowling performance by the South African bowlers. They were a bit off-target in the middle overs but a strong start and an equally strong finish have ensured they are not chasing a big target here. England, on the other hand, would have loved to get at least 250 on the board but need to back their bowling now if they want to register their first win of this World Cup.
Another brace to end the innings! Slower one short and wide, Ecclestone finds the gap at cover-point and pushes hard for two. She gets it with ease in the end and England Women finish with 235/9!
Excellent running! A length ball, over middle. Sophie Ecclestone hangs back and hits it aerially down to the left of deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs around and the batters are able to get two.
Full and wide, squeezed out to short third man for a quick single.
Ecclestone wants two but it is never on. On middle, heaved towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Brilliant fielding from Chloe Tryon. Fullish delivery, on off. Anya Shrubsole looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to the right of short third man. Tryon dives full stretch and saves a certain boundary. Just the single taken.
On middle, heaved away leg side for a single.
Anya Shrubsole is the last batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Ayabonga Khaka finally gets the yorker perfect and hits the bullseye! This is very full, at the base of middle stump. Charlotte Dean makes a bit of room leg side, looking to cover drive. The ball just sneaks underneath her blade and hits the middle stump on the full. Khaka has her wicket and Dean has to go.
Sliding down the leg side, Dean looks to flick but gets it off the pads and straight into the keeper's mitss.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for England! Khaka misses the yorker again and delivers a low full toss, on off stump. Charlotte Dean shows great skill to get inside the line of the ball and lap it wide of short fine leg. The fielder over there can't get a hand to it and the ball trickles away into the fence.
Full and straight, pushed down to long on for one.
WIDE! Khaka misses the yorker at the toes and spills it down the leg side. Ecclestone misses the flick and a wide is called.
Length again, around middle. This is tucked away through square leg for a run.
A length ball on the pads. Ecclestone picks it off her hips and plays it towards fine leg. She picks up a single.
Very full again, on off. This is pushed down to long on by Ecclestone for just another single.
Very full, at the base of the off stump. Ecclestone digs it out to mid off.
Shorter in length, around off. Dean pulls it down to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and wide, Dean can't get it past the fielder at cover.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Charlotte Dean is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Five wickets for Marizanne Kapp and it has been an absolute masterclass from her today! Kate Cross advances down the track and Kapp sees that. Kapp drags back the length considerably and bowls it a lot slower. Cross looks to get it over mid off but gets a top edge which is skied towards short third man. Chloe Tryon settles under it and takes a fine catch. South Africa Women ending the innings very strongly here.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle and leg, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for just a single this time.
Very full and straight, this is bunted back over the bowler's head for a single.
A length ball, sliding onto the pads. Sophie Ecclestone clips it to the right of deep mid-wicket and races back for the second.
On middle, pushed down the ground towards long on for one.

FOUR! Excellent effort in the deep but it goes in vain! This is on the pads, Cross picks it up and flicks it aerially towards the square leg fence. The substitute fielder, Tumi Sekhukhune runs to her right and puts in the dive but can't quite reach it. The ball ends up in the fence.
On the pads, worked through square leg for a single.

Ooh, that seemed a little too close for comfort! An off-spinning slower delivery, on a length and around off. Kate Cross shuffles across to get inside the line of the ball and looks to scoop it over the keeper's head. She misses and the ball misses the top of off stump by a whisker.
On off, pushed towards mid off.
Angled into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! A length ball, sliding down the leg side. Wided.
Sophie Ecclestone walks in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Marizanne Kapp is doing a fine job in the absence of Shabnim Ismail and these wickets are slowing down England Women considerably. Another slower ball, this is pitched up around the off pole. Sophia Dunkley gets low and looks to pull it away. The ball takes agae sto arrive and Dunkley is way early into her shot. The ball loops up off the top edge and Trisha Chetty takes a dolly of a catch behind the stumps.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: TWO WIDES! This one is spilled way down the leg side, Cross doesn't get any bat on it and Chetty fumbles. They scamper through as well.
On middle, driven down towards wide long on for just a single.
Kate Cross is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant from Marizanne Kapp as she picks up her third wicket of the day! Slower delivery, bowled into the deck and around off. Katherine Brunt steps out of her crease, makes room and looks to go inside out over extra cover. She gets undone by the lack of pace and ends up lifting it towards covers. The substitute fielder, Tumi Sekhukhune settles under it and takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Tumi Sekhukhune b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Six singles coming off the over! Full and at the toes, jammed out to long on for a single.
Full, on middle. Dunkley whips it through mid-wicket for a single. The 200 is now up for England Women.
Khaka is keeping it full and bowls this one around off. Brunt muscles it down to long off for one more.
Full and straight, drilled down to long on for  asingle.
A length ball, sliding into leg stump. Katherine Brunt makes room to play the big heave but gets it off the leading edge onto the off side. Single taken.
Leg bye! Full and down the leg side Dunkley pads it away towards point for a quick single

NOT OUT! This is a low full toss and outside off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it to extra-cover and there is amix-up between the batters as they try to take a single. However, the throw is under arm towards the keeper's end and a single is completed. The replays confirm the same as the leg umpire takes it upstairs.
Is that a Run-Out? The keeper Trisha Chetty doesn't seem excited but the umpires have gone upstairs. The third umpire checks the replay and Katherine Brunt was well in. NOT OUT!
Back of a length, around leg. Brunt pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length delivery on middle and leg. Brunt skips down the track and ends up hitting it back to the bowler.
On a length, on middle. Brunt skips down the track and manges to hit it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
This time a full toss around leg. Brunt drives it to mid on.
A full delivery on off. Sophia Dunkley makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side. She gets the inside half of his blade to long on for a single.
Masabata Klaas (7-1-18-2) comes back into the attack.

Ohh...dropped but a tough chance this one! A shorter delivery on middle. Brunt pulls it to deep square leg. She fails to get enough distance and the ball goes in the air towards the deep square leg region. The fielder in the deep runs forward and dives forward to take the catch. However, she fails to pouch it and a couple of runs are taken.
A full delivery, on off. Sophia Dunkley hits this to long off for a single.
A yorker this time on middle. Sophia Dunkley tries to dig it out but gets the inside edge just past stumps towards fine leg.
A slower length delivery, around off. Brunt skips down the track and hits this to extra-cover for a single.
Full delivery on middle this time. Sophia Dunkley drills it to long on for a single.
A full delivery, around off. Sophia Dunkley hits this back to the bowler.
Ayabonga Khaka (6-0-31-0) is back on.
Slightly shorter around off. Sophia Dunkley cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on middle this time. Brunt works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter on off. Sophia Dunkley chops it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly shorter on middle. Sophia Dunkley works it towards the deep backward square leg region for a couple.
Goes fuller around off. Brunt pushes it towards covers for a single.
This is outside off and Brunt looks to reverse-scoop it but misses.
This is full on off. Brunt pushes it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Tossed up around off. Brunt makes room and goes inside-out over extra cover for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on off. Brunt pushes it towards the off side.
This is full and outside off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it back to the bowler.
A full toss on leg. Sophia Dunkley sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple.
On a length, wide of off and this is cut away straight to point.
Fired in full and close to the off pole. This is jammed out to cover.
Risky single yet again! On off, firmly driven towards mid off. Sophia Dunkley sets off for the single and luckily for her the fielder missed the direct hit.
A low full toss, on the pads. Brunt works it towards deep square leg for a single.
A tad bit short, around off. Dunkley cuts it to deep point for a run.
Full and straight, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Short and wide outside off. Brunt cuts it to point.
Tossed up on off. Brunt pushes it to short cover.
This is full on off. Brunt drives it towards covers.
Tossed up nicely on off. Brunt drives it to mid off.
Tossed up again, on off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it to long on this time.
This is fuller on off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it to mid off.
Katherine Brunt is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Just when South Africa Women needed a wicket, they have got one! Fuller and on middle. Sophia Dunkley just bunts it out on the leg side and looks for the quick single. There is a bit of hesitation but Amy Jones scampers through. Marizanne Kapp attacks the ball well from short mid-wicket and underarms the throw to Trisha Chetty who wastes no time in whipping off the bails. The replays roll in and Jones is short of her crease. End of a good innings from her.
Is this a run out? The replays roll in and they show that Amy Jones is short of her crease. So she has to walk back and a big wicket for South Africa Women.
Flatter delivery, cutaway to point.
Excellent running! Tossed up around off and this is driven towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs by Sophia Dunkley.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Leg bye.
Nicely bowled! Drifted into middle and leg, the ball grips and turns. Dunkley gets a leading edge on it.
Sliding down leg, Dunkley looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits her pads and goes towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Around off, this is firmly driven but straight towards mid off.
On middle, Dunkley steps out and drills it to mid on.
Slower and on middle. Jones turns kity through mid-wicket for yet another one.
On the pads this time, Dunkley gets low and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.

Fifty for Amy Jones! Her first in a World Cup game too and what a time to step up. This is pushed well outside off, Jones reaches out and taps it to sweeper cover for one. She will now look to stay there till the end and help her team put on a good score on the board.
Flatter again, sliding into middle and leg. Dunkley hangs back and nudges it through mid-wicket for one.
Slightly flighted, on off. Dunkley defends it out.
Shorter ball, on off. Dunkley fails to get it away.
Good running! Flatter, around off. Sophia Dunkley rocks back and pushes it out through the cover region. The fielder in the deep has a fumble and they get back for two.
Short ball, outside off. Jones hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. She moves on to 49 now.
A full toss this time down the leg side. Sophia Dunkley pulls it towards the backward square leg region for a couple.
Injury Update! The news from the South African dressing room is that the injury to Shabnim Ismail is an issue with the toe. It doesn't seem as bad as expected and she might bowl later in the innings.
Flighted delivery on off. Sophia Dunkley gets forward and blocks it out.
This is full again, on off. Jones drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
This time a bit short and around off. Sophia Dunkley cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Jones drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off. Jones pushes it towards point.
Sophia Dunkley walks in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! This time Klaas gets the wicket and the drop catch earlier in the over doesn't cost much. A big wicket and the partnership is finally broken. A good length delivery, around off and this one nips back in sharply. Tammy Beaumont looks to defend it but misses. The ball hits her pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises the finger and Tammy Beaumont after discussing with her partner decides to not review it. She walks back disappointed. A very good innings comes to an end.
A slower delivery around off. Tammy Beaumont pushes it towards the off side.
Goes fuller on middle. Tammy Beaumont drives it to mid on.
This is full on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers.
On a length, on middle. Tammy Beaumont works it towards square leg.

FOUR! Ohh...dropped! A tough chance though and keeper Trisha Chetty fails to pouch it. Tammy Beaumont skips down the track a tad early and Klaas delivers this full and wide outside off. Tammy Beaumont goes for a drive but gets a thick outside edge. It goes to the right of the keeper. She dives but its just a bit out of reach and gets a glove on it. The ball races away for a boundary.
Masabata Klaas (6-1-14-1) is back into the attack.
This time she finds the gap. A fuller delivery, on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker and outside off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers. Finds the fielder in the ring.
Tossed up this time on middle. Jones eases it down to long on for a single.
This is flatter and outside off. Jones goes for a big booming drive but misses.

WIDE! This is fuller and down the leg side. Tammy Beaumont looks to sweep it but misses. 100 runs partnership comes up. A crucial one for England.
Luus starts with a flatter delivery and outside off. Tammy Beaumont chops it towards backward point.

Drinks! Well, the flow of the innings has changed in the last hour and England Women are in a really good position now to go on and get a big score on the board. Tammy Beaumont has surpassed fifty yet again against South Africa, she just loves to bat against them and together with Amy Jones has put on a 99-run stand so far. South African spinners have been ineffective and they have been below par in the middle overs. They desperately need to break this partnership in order to get back into the match. Another thing of concern is that Shabnim Ismail is seen walking off the pitch. How much difference is that going to make if Ismail isn't able to bowl in this innings? Also, Sune Luus (2-0-12-0) is back on.
This time she goes full on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to deep extra-cover for a single. 11 runs from the over!
FOUR! Another boundary and England are moving along nicely now! Back of a length, outside off. Tammy Beaumont cuts this through the backward point region for a boundary.
WIDE! A slower length delivery and down the leg side. Tammy Beaumont looks to clip it but misses.
A length delivery, outside off. Jones chops it to sweeper cover for a single.
Very full this time on off. Jones blocks this one out.
FOUR! This time a bit short and punished! Shorter length delivery on middle. Jones pulls it towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Kapp bowls a yorker this time on off. Jones does well and digs it out.
On a length, around off. Jones drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Overpitched delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont steers it towards third man for a single.
Fullish delivery on off. Jones drives it to long on for a single.

Fifty for Tammy Beaumont! Brilliant knock under pressure in a crucial game for her team. She would like to get a big one here. A full delivery of off. Tammy Beaumont drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
This is full again, on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers.
A full delivery, on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers and there is a slight misfield there but no run taken.
Full and straight, tailing in a bit. Jones pushes it out to mid on.
This is angled into the pads, Beaumont with a whippy shot down to deep square leg for a single.
Kapp goes slower this time and bowls it a bit shorter and outside off. Jones waits for it and eases it down to deep cover for a run.
Outside off, worked away towards covers.
Full again, outside off. Beaumont walks towards the bowler and looks to cover drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, outside off and there's a bit of away shape on this one. Beaumont mistimes the drive on the off side.
Marizanne Kapp (5-1-15-2) is back into the attack. Can she provide the breakthrough?
This is very wide of the off stump and Beaumont goes chasing after it. She gets an outside edge down towards third man and picks up a single.
Full and wide, driven towards deep cover for another easy brace. England Women going through the gears now.
Wide outside off, driven through the cover region for another single.
Width on offer and this is tapped through covers for one.
FOUR! Glorious! Pitched up, on middle. Beaumont with a cracking straight drive which ends up in the long on fence.

Excellent running! Full and wide, this is driven to the right of sweeper cover. The batters run one and Jones realizes it's Lizelle Lee down there and calls her partner for the second. They make it with ease.
Ayabonga Khaka (4-0-16-0) is back on.
Full again, outside off. This is tapped towards the cover region.
Full and straight, played with an angled bat towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Klaas sees Amy Jones advancing and tries to fire it in at the pads but spills it down the leg side. Wided.
Pitched up, on off. This is pushed towards mid off.
Leg bye! Angled on the pads, Beaumont looks to tickle it away but misses. The ball comes off the pads and rolls towards backward square leg. The keeper gives chase and the batters pick up a leg bye.
WIDE! A bumper now, a little bit too high and down the leg side. Wide called.
On middle and leg, played towards mid-wicket.
Full and wide, jammed out towards backward point by Beaumont.
Tossed up, outside off. Jones with a firm cover drive but can't get it through the gap.
Floated up, on off. Jones blocks it out.
FOUR! After missing out on a couple of full tosses earlier, Amy Jones punishes this one. On the hips, Jones steps out and muscles it into the square leg fence.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Shorter this time, cutaway to deep point for a run.
FOUR! First signs of intent from Amy Jones. Tossed up, on off. Jones makes room and steps out. She then goes inside-out and gets it past wide mid off for a boundary.
Angled into middle and leg, clipped away through mid-wicket for a single. Just the two singles off the over. Nothing much is happening at the moment and something needs to give her for either side.
Full again, around off. Nicely driven towards covers by Amy Jones but once again she cannot find the gap.
On middle, this is pushed firmly towards mid on by Jones.
Slower delivery, pitched up and on off. Jones looks to drive but is a little bit early in her shot, ends up pushing it towards mid off.
Full and wide, Beaumont squeezes it down to third man for a single.
Full and straight, this is drilled towards mid on.
Ayabonga Khaka (4-1-10-1) is back on.
This one is slower on off. Jones skips down the track and pushes it to mid off. Very good over this. A maiden from Chloe Tryon!
Flatter and slightly short on off. Jones tries to cut it but is cramped for room.
This is flatter and around off. Jones only manages to push it towards the off side.
Slower and loopy delivery on off. Jones drives it to covers.
This time flatter and on off. Jones defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off. Jones pushes it to covers.
Slightly shorter on off. Jones cuts it left of sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to deep cover for a single.
Slightly quicker around off. Tammy Beaumont dabs it to point.
Goes slightly shorter around off. Jones punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly shorter delivery on off. Jones pulls it right of long on for a couple.
WIDE! This is way too wide outside off. Jones leaves it alone.
NO BALL! Oh...this time she bowls this way too short and the ball goes towards the keeper with couple of bounces off the pitch as Jones leaves it. No ball called by the umpire.
Slower and shorter outside off. Jones chops it towards point.
Slightly shorter around off. Jones punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle and slightly quicker. Tammy Beaumont works it towards the backward square leg region and initially looks for a couple but settles for a single.
Slower and on off. Tammy Beaumont defends it towards the off side off the front foot.
Goes fuller on middle. Jones pushes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off. Jones pushes it towards the off side off the front foot.
Slightly short around off. Jones chops it to point.
Shorter and outside off. Tammy Beaumont punches it to covers.
ohh... third full toss in the row! On middle and leg. Jones hits it to fine leg for a single.
Another friendly full toss on middle. Tammy Beaumont misses out and only manages to hit it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss this time on middle. Jones only manages to sweep it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Tammy Beaumont punches this left of mid off for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Jones hits this to long on for a single.
The skipper, Sune Luus to bowl now.
On middle and quicker. Tammy Beaumont works it towards mid-wicket.

On the shorter side but little close to off. Tammy Beaumont goes back and punches it to mid off.

Length ball, jagging back into middle from around off. Beaumont blocks it out.

Half an appeal from the bowler and nothing more. Good-length, around off and nipping back in sharply off the surface. Beaumont almost gets cut in half and gets an inside edge onto the back leg.
FOUR! Just a bit too straight and Beaumont takes full advantage. A half-volley on the pads, clipped away into the square leg fence for a boundary.
Nicely bowled! Scrambled seam delivery, on a nagging length and around the fifth-stump line. Beaumont is pushed onto the front foot to block but gets beaten past the outside edge.

Around off, this is pushed onto the off side.
Flatter, on off. Beaumont defends it out.
Tryon starts off with a shorter delivery, on middle. Beaumont hops back and pulls it straight down to short mid-wicket.
Time for some spin now. Chloe Tryon is brought into the attack.
Another brilliant over from Klaas, she picks up a maiden. Full and at the toes, squeezed out towards short leg by Jones.
Pitched up and angling into middle and leg. Jones flicks it towards mid on.
Good-looking shot for no run! Full and outside off, classically driven by Jones but straight to cover.
On a good length, over off. Amy Jones goes on the back foot and fend sit off towards mid-wicket.
This time Jones pushes the ball on middle back to the bowler with soft hands.
A length ball, hugging the tramline. Jones reaches out and taps it towards covers.

Drinks! It's been a brilliant opening hour for South Africa Women. Both Shabnim Ismail and Marizanne Kapp troubled the English batters but it was Kapp who got rid of Danni Wyatt and then the English skipper, Heather Knight as well. Natalie Sciver was looking really good and was counterattacking but a strange dismissal has sent her packing as well. With Beaumont still at the crease, England Women will believe they can put on a good score. For South Africa it's simple, get rid of Beaumont and they will have control of this innings.

Goes fuller on middle. Tammy Beaumont drives it right of the bowler. She stops it.
A length delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont defends it solidly towards the off side.
Overpitched around off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers but fails to find the gap.
On a length, around off. Jones pushes it towards covers and takes a quick single.
This is very full and outside off. Tammy Beaumont looks to drive it away but misses.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor delivery this and gives away a boundary. On a length and around leg. Tammy Beaumont looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits her thigh pad and goes off for a boundary towards long leg.
Back of a length, on middle. Jones works it towards fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Jones works it towards the leg side.

This is full, on off. Tammy Beaumont drives straight down the ground and it goes through Klass as she tries to stop it. The ball goes towards mid off and Shabnim Ismail there makes a direct hit but Tammy Beaumont is quick and completes the single easily.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leaves it alone.
Overpitched on off. Tammy Beaumont pushes it to mid on and takes a single.
Another full delivery, on off. Jones drives it to deep cover for a single.
A fullish delivery around off. Jones looks to drive but fails to connect it with the middle of her blade.
This time on a length, around off. Jones pushes it square on the off side.
Another full delivery on middle. Jones drives again but straight to mid on again.
Full delivery on middle and a bit of in swing this time. Jones drives it to mid on.
Very full and outside off, Beaumont makes an easy leave. Just 2 runs and a big wicket coming off Masabata Klaas' first over.
This is full and around off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers.
This is full and outside off. Jones guides it to third man for a single.
Amy Jones is in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Disaster for England Women! This is one of the strangest dismissal you will see but it has come at a wrong time for England. This is short and down the leg side. Natalie Sciver looks to pull it but the ball catches some part of the blade and goes onto hit her thigh pad. The ball then takes the behind of the bat and ends up looping up in the air towards first slip and Lizelle Lee takes an easy catch. Unlucky but she has to walk back and a big wicket for South Africa.
Commentary.Howout: c Lizelle Lee b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: This time it is angling on middle and leg. Fuller and Natalie Sciver clips it past square leg for a couple.
On a length, on off. Natalie Sciver blocks it out.
Masabata Klaas is now brought into the attack.
This time it is full on middle. Natalie Sciver drives it to long on for a single.
Fulller delivery, on off. Sciver drives it to covers.

NOT OUT! This is fuller on off. Natalie Sciver drives it straight down the ground. It goes towards right of Ayabonga Khaka. She tries to stop it but gets fingers on it and the ball goes onto hit the stumps. Tammy Beaumont is backing up a little bit too much and dives to make her ground. The umpire takes the decision upstairs. The replays show that the bat is inside the crease and Tammy Beaumont survives.

Is that a Run-Out? Ayabonga Khaka does well to get a fingertip on the ball which goes on to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. The umpires have gone upstairs and it is a difficult one for the third umpire. The replays roll in and it is a question of whether Beaumont's bat was grounded before the bails came off.
Fullish delivery on off. Natalie Sciver drives it to mid off.
Pulls her length back a little. Serves this on a length, on off. Natalie Sciver blocks it out.
This is full outside off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to deep cover for a single.
Powerplay 2! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A touch fuller, on middle and this is nudged towards mid-wicket. At the end of the first Powerplay, England Women are 38/2!
Good-length, a tad wider. Sciver hangs back and cuts it towards backward point.
Around the top of off, kept out by Sciver.
A length ball, on middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! Natalie Sciver is now taking the game to the South African bowlers! Slightly overpitched, around off. Sciver keeps her head still and just strokes it through the gap at extra cover for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, tailing into the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a single by Beaumont.
FOUR! This hasn't been a good start for Ayabonga Khaka. Short again, on middle. This one sits up nicely for the batter and Sciver pulls it along the ground, into the mid-wicket fence.
Unlucky! This is short and wide again, Sciver slaps it off the back foot but finds the fielder perfectly at cover-point.
Right on the money! Around the top of middle. Sciver stays solid in defense.
Around middle and leg, kept out on the leg side.
WIDE! Khaka spills this one down the leg side and a wide is signalled.
This is angled into middle, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Short and wide, punished by Natalie Sciver. Sciver rocks back and slaps it past point to pick up a welcome boundary.
Full and wide again, really close to the tramline. Beaumont with an easy leave and Marizanne Kapp delivers a maiden over.
Fullish delivery, pushed outside off. Beaumont makes another leave.
Kapp is creating a lot of doubt in the batter's mind. Good-length, close to the off pole. Beaumont is caught in two minds and the ball just beats the outside edge of her blade yet again.
This is much wider and Beaumont leaves it alone.
Review! South Africa Women have taken a review for caught behind! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. So the original decision stays and Tammy Beaumont can continue.

NOT OUT! Tammy Beaumont walks down the track and Marizanne Kapp sees her coming. Kapp serves a length ball, around off and this one shapes away ever so slightly. Beaumont tries to block it out but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Kapp seems a bit interested and eventually they o review it. The replays show that there is a clear gap between bat and ball and UltraEdge confirms the same. A hopeful review but a wasteful one.

Kapp almost does it again! On a nagging length, close to the off pole. Tammy Beaumont looks to leave it but just like Knight, she is late to get the bat away in time. Luckily for her, the ball doesn't go on to hit the stumps after taking the inside edge.
On middle, gently pushed towards mid on.
A bit of width on offer and this is thrashed away towards point for a quick single.
Almost yorker length, curving back in at the toes of Beaumont who does really well to jam it out on the leg side.
On the pads and Sciver flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and straight, punched straight towards mid on by Sciver.

Full and straight, a hint of shape on it. Tammy Beaumont plays a whippy shot and gets it through the mid-wicket region. A couple of fielders give chase but the batters do well to come back for the third.
Full and wide, Natalie Sciver leaves it alone.
A length ball, jagging back in from around off. Sciver stays watchful in defense.
Natalie Sciver is the next batter in.

OUT! Chopped back on! This is a huge, huge wicket and Marizanne Kapp has sent the English skipper packing. This is pitched a bit further up and bowled outside off. Heather Knight puts out a stride and looks to make a watchful leave but she leaves her bat dangling and is late to get it out of the way. The ball takes the inside edge and goes on to hit the off stump. Knight was looking good out there but Kapp has provided her team with the perfect start.
A touch slower, on middle and blocked out by Knight.
Right around the top of off. Knight with a solid front-foot defense onto the off side.
Kapp strays in line and serves a half-volley on the pads. Knight clips it through mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
Excellent over, a maiden from Shabnim Ismail! This is on a good length, on off. Tammy Beaumont gets forward and blocks it carefully.
Another delivery on that tight line, on off. Tammy Beaumont is solid in her defence.
On a length, on off. Tammy Beaumont blocks this off the inside half of her blade.
Fullish again, on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to covers.
Again that bit of outswing! A good-length delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont gets forward and looks to push at it but the ball swing away and beats the outside edge of her blade.
A good-length delivery, outside off and shaping away this time. Tammy Beaumont leaves it alone.
FOUR! Nicely played! This will give her lot of confidence. This is fullish outside off. Knight leans forward and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
This time drifting on the pads and a tad fuller. Knight flicks it past square leg for a couple.
Slightly shorter in length, on off at 117 kph. Knight blocks it out.
On a good length, around off. Knight defends it towards covers.
On a length and angling into middle. Knight works it towards the leg side.
A length delivery, on off. Heather Knight blocks it out.
Ohh..good end to the over! A good-length delivery and shaping away this time. Tammy Beaumont looks to get a bat on it but the ball beats the outside edge of her blade.
A good-length delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont dabs it towards the off side.
FOUR! Just what England needed to calm their nerves! A length delivery, on off. Tammy Beaumont heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
NO BALL! A length delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leaves it alone. Shabnim Ismail has overstepped and a Free Hit coming up now.
Slightly on the shorter side again, around off. Knight steers it towards deep third man for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Tammy Beaumont works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is full on off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to mid off.
Heather Knight is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! So the move to send Danni Wyatt up the order hasn't worked. She departs early and South Africa Women get an early breakthrough! This is on a good-length and shaping away from the batter. Danni Wyatt goes for a drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards point and Laura Wolvaardt fumbles a little with the catch but ends up catching it finally. A big wicket this and England Women are in early trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Laura Wolvaardt b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: This time a bit of width offered. Danni Wyatt creams it through cover-point for a couple.
A good-length delivery, on off. Danni Wyatt gets forward and blocks this solidly.
Back of a length this time, on off. Danni Wyatt looks to pull but gets the inside edge onto her pads.
This time closer to the off pole. A good-length delivery and Danni Wyatt gets forward to block it.
Ohhh...a bit of away shape straightaway! A good-length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt tries to push at it but gets beaten off the outside edge.
Marizanne Kapp to operate with the other new ball.
This time a good-length delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leaves it alone. Good start by Shabnim Ismail.
Ohh...almost a wicket there! This time a yorker on off. Tammy Beaumont tries to dig it out but gets an inside edge just past the stumps.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont lets it go watchfully.
Drags her length back a little this time. It is around off and Danni Wyatt steers it to third man for a single. She is off the mark as well.
A fullish delivery, outside off again. This time a bit of shape away from the batter. Danni Wyatt leaves it alone.
Tammy Beaumont and England Women are underway! Shabnim Ismail starts with a full delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to deep cover for a single.

Done with the pre-game formalities and it's now time to play! The South African team is seen in a huddle before making their way out to the ground. Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt are the opening batters for England Women. Shabnim Ismail has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Before the start though, players from both teams take the knee to show their support for the BLM movement. Let's go...

We are moments away from the start of the match. But before that, the two sides line up for their respective national anthems. It will be England's national anthem first, followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

Nasser Hussain is down for the pitch report. He says that it looks a perfect pitch. He adds that it looks an absolute belter and it might grip later in the day. He mentions that the bowlers have to drag back a length a bit but overall it is a very good pitch.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women says that they would have bat first and it looks a bit dry. She informs that they have one change in their team. She says that they want to start winning games now and take one game at a time. Tells that they have to remain calm and they have had good preparation. Says that they can hopefully perform and show what they can do on this pitch.

Sune Luus, the skipper of South Africa Women says that they will bowl first. She says that the wicket looks good and they will like to chase the target. She adds that it is exciting to see that they have won games though they have not played well and there best is yet to come. States that England Women are a competitive side and it comes down to who will do the basics right. She informs that they are going with an unchanged XI.

England Women (Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Kate Cross, Charlotte Dean (In place of Lauren Winfield), Anya Shrubsole.

South Africa Women ( Unchanged Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas, Ayabonga Khaka.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of South Africa Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

After letting the match slip against Australia, the reigning champions had a poor outing with the bat against West Indies in their second match. Chasing 220 odd runs, they got bundled out for 217 after Danni Wyatt and Sophia Dunkley had put them in command. This is deeply concerning for Heather Knight and her troops because not being able to get over the line in close encounters is a difficult pill to swallow. Another loss here and their campaign might all but be over already. Will South Africa Women continue their charge? Or will we finally see the might of the defending champions? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

What a brilliant start to the tournament it has been for South Africa Women! They have been able to defend under-par totals on two occasions now and while their batting hasn't quite fired, the bowlers have been excellent. In their last match against Pakistan, Shabnim Ismail held her nerve in the final over to see her side home but they do need an improvement in the batting department as they look to inflict more misery on the reigning champions.

Hello and a warm welcome to match number 13 of the 2022 Women's World Cup between South Africa Women and England Women live from Bay Oval in Mount Maunganui. Two sides in the opposite end of the table and a win here for South Africa will see them make it 3 wins out of 3 whereas the defending champions are looking for their first win to kickstart their campaign.
